reason: 该插件面向用户的核心是 MCP 服务管理：在 DSH 的设置界面提供 MCP 服务器配置的新增/编辑/删除与 `mcp__` 工具浏览，并通过 `/api/mcp-manager` 与 `mcp_server_*` 工具执行管理操作，配置数据来自 `cordis.patch.yml` 并支持 HMR 实时挂载。依据 README 显示的明文凭据存储说明（P0）与可配置的传输命令参数，当前风险为中等。

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DSH 的 MCP 管理面板，提供 MCP 服务器配置的增删改查、工具列表浏览，并配套提供 agent 侧 `mcp_server_*` 管理能力。
summaries.en: This plugin is an MCP management panel for DSH, offering add/edit/delete workflows for MCP server configs, browsing of MCP tools, and accompanying agent-side `mcp_server_*` management commands.

capabilities: Read and write MCP server configuration in profile `cordis.patch.yml`
Expose REST endpoints for MCP server CRUD, tools listing, and status
Provide settings-panel UI for MCP server list/edit/delete and tool browsing
Register agent tools for listing/adding/updating/removing MCP servers
Support HMR-based configuration reload after changes
Support stdio and streamable-http transport settings for MCP servers

reasons.code: README explicitly states `env`/`headers` are persisted in plain text in `cordis.patch.yml`, flagged as a P0 concern.
Management flows are implemented as HTTP routes (`/api/mcp-manager/*`) that mutate server configuration and return runtime state.
Repository/package metadata indicate direct integration with MCP client tooling and transport configuration (`command`, `args`, `url`, `headers`) for external connections.
